title: Write a standalone PR description
prompt: The reader has no earlier conversation. Write a concise pull-request description for a reviewer who has not seen the chat. Include the trigger, changed behavior and validation limits. Preserve the supplied file path, command and count. Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior): - Problem: an imported mod’s summary could be inserted into the webview as active HTML. - Change: extension/media/mods-panel.js renders summaries and preview content as text nodes. - A regression supplies and checks that it remains literal text with no image element. - Validation: node test/unit/mods-panel.js passed; 14 focused host checks also passed. - A packaged UI scenario is prepared but has not run.
input_facts: Problem: an imported mod’s summary could be inserted into the webview as active HTML.
Change: extension/media/mods-panel.js renders summaries and preview content as text nodes.
A regression supplies and checks that it remains literal text with no image element.
Validation: node test/unit/mods-panel.js passed; 14 focused host checks also passed.
A packaged UI scenario is prepared but has not run.

required_facts_for_human_review.description: An imported mod’s summary was the active-HTML trigger.
The affected path and the text-node rendering change are stated.
Hostile markup remains literal and does not create an image element.
The named Node command and 14 focused host checks passed.
Prepared packaged scenario source does not establish rendered UI verification.

literal_check_notice: Advisory exact-evidence diagnostics only. A literal flag cannot decide acceptance or fact preservation. Numeric substring matches can be misleading; a human may mark the semantic fact preserved despite a missing numeric literal (for example, a correctly spelled-out number). Verbatim paths, errors, commands and citations matter where the prompt requests them. All semantic facts and quality ratings require a human.
